title: Tropical Baseline Delta and Receipt Proof
summary: Introduces a baseline-comparison primitive (src/hb_assistant/construction/baseline.py) that reads the historic counts on a canonical source's baseline block, reads the live counts from V2 construction_drive_item_inventory, computes per-metric drift, and classifies the result (matches / within_tolerance / drift_detected / never_crawled / no_baseline_recorded). The delta crawler embeds the BaselineComparison on every successful CrawlReceipt when the source carries baseline metadata, and in apply mode also persists a row to the V5 construction_processing_receipts table with operation='baseline_comparison'. Dry-run computes the comparison without persisting. No CLI changes, no schema changes, no Graph round-trip, no source-document copies.

tropical_baseline_snapshot.interpretation: The Tropical canonical source carries the seed historic baseline (8921 unique items / 7208 files / 1713 folders / 39.78 GB). The live SQLite inventory is empty (no Graph crawl has been authorized in this non-interactive shell), so the comparison correctly classifies as 'never_crawled' with the full historic surfaced for visibility and drift fully populated. After an authorized live crawl populates construction_drive_item_inventory, the same primitive will reclassify to matches / within_tolerance / drift_detected based on observed counts.

dry_run_crawl_receipt.shape: CrawlReceipt now includes baseline_comparison as an optional field. In dry-run mode the comparison is computed from current store state and embedded in the returned receipt; no row is written to construction_processing_receipts.

apply_crawl_receipt.shape: Apply mode also calls store.insert_processing_receipt with receipt_id='{run_id}:baseline_comparison', operation='baseline_comparison', status=<comparison.status>, detail=<full comparison json>.
apply_crawl_receipt.duplicate_safety: receipt_id is namespaced by run_id, so multiple crawls of the same source never collide on the V5 primary key
